file_id: M-S Agrawal Agencies vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 December, 2016

sentences.text:
M/S Agrawal Agencies vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13
December, 2016
 Mcrc-4325-2008
 (M/S Agrawal Agencies Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
13-12-2016
Shri Manish Awasthy, Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Ramesh Kushwaha, Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant pleads no instructions in the matter.

As this petition was filed in the year 2008 seeking discharge from prosecution under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act in Criminal Case No.1248/2002 and as there is very possibility that trial of the case is concluded, by passage of time the applicant is not interested to prosecute this case.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.

(SUBHASH KAKADE) JUDGE sj M/S Agrawal Agencies vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 December, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170639047/
